_comment: Known Contiki-NG development controls: seven accepts and eight rejects. Gold answers are scoring data, never model inputs.
Holds are abstentions, not correct rejects. Decision agreement is separate from exact-plan validation.
Includes prior evaluation cases retired into development; does not estimate unseen or population accuracy.
Several rejects have no disjoint production patch under the protected-test boundary; coverage is intentionally biased.

255.note: Prior validated upstream list regression, including three before repeats.

3020.note: Prior validated signed CBOR API compile oracle; no P2P in blocked binary.

3195.note: Prior validated CBOR accessor/skip API compile oracle; no P2P in blocked binary.

3246.note: Prior valid JSON receipt establishes four F2P and two P2P. Latest minimal-set model plan is being validated separately.

3202.note: Independent Antelope observation and untouched model accept validation both show named F2P/P2P.

3261.note: Independent CoAP observation establishes three F2P/two P2P; correct gold plan still needs repeated-before final validation.

2830.note: Source: new heapmem_calloc API is PR purpose and absent at base; fixed upstream zero_init_alloc case requires it. Runtime/build verification pending.

384.note: Only protected compile-runner output field widths change; no disjoint production fix.

958.note: Only protected simulation timing changes; no disjoint production fix, and timeout alone is not a permitted oracle.

1769.note: Only protected shared runner checks change; no disjoint production fix under current instance boundary.

2587.note: Only adds simple-node/z1 to protected compile registration; production patch empty.

3251.note: Only protected AES failure reporting changes; no disjoint production patch or supplied intentional failing input.

3057.note: Only braces in protected SHA-256 test are edited; no production patch.

422.note: Source review: production token changes are documentation and braces around unchanged single return statements; remaining production C/H token streams unchanged. Protected tests/style changes provide no detecting assertion.

1170.note: New vector-decoding helper is absent at base and required by fixed tests; the PR purpose is AES length handling. Incidental compile failure is explicitly disallowed by the run contract; no representable alternative supported consumer is established.
